OBSERVATION WORKBENCH

Multi-wavelength Explorer

Compare observations of the same patch of sky in different kinds of light. Use the layers to see which features appear across wavelengths and which stand out in a particular band.

Try the synthetic demo. Toggle the visible and infrared layers to see how the bright ring changes, then click a point to inspect its wavelength and intensity. The chart stacks layers by wavelength, so the gap between layers shows a difference in wavelength rather than a distance in space.

Observation layers

    Brightness is scaled separately for each layer. Read the original intensity and unit below the chart when selecting a point.

    Prepare calibrated FITS images and cubes with prepare_observations.py. Files are opened locally in your browser.
